topic.angle: A small voltage or current controls a larger current, so it can switch on and off

card.title: A transistor is a solid-state switch

body.claim: A transistor can act as an electrically controlled switch.
body.why: A voltage or current applied to one pair of a transistor's terminals controls the current through another pair. Because the control can be switched on and off, the transistor can act as a switch. The transistor was invented in 1947.

probes.question: What controls the current through one pair of a transistor's terminals?
options: A voltage or current applied to another pair of terminals

probes.question: True or false: a transistor can be used as an electrically controlled switch.
